svg.title: coderprint: 802k lines of code in use, of 1.7M written, all time
svg.desc: 802,002 lines of code in use (497,526 in production, 304,476 in tests), of 1,696,446 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 4,273 commits across all branches, 86 active days, a longest streak of 40 days, a current streak of 16 days, and 6 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 1.6M lines of code. The bars end on 18NOV2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 60%, Lean 16%, Python 15%, TypeScript 4%, JavaScript 3%, Shell 1%, other languages under 1%. Of what was written, 47% is kept.
